messages:
marco: Quick sync: we need a compact GA acceptance playbook for next Wednesday. Focused items: SLA pass/fail tests, customer credit policy, runbook rollback steps, docs + SDK examples, and alerting thresholds. Can we map owners now?

anya: I can own docs + SDK. Current gaps: streaming example for long responses, pagination + backpressure note, and an ops-friendly quickstart. I'll have PRs by Tue afternoon.

devon: I'll take SLA test harness + rollout automation. Proposed SLOs: 99.9% availability, p99 <= 500ms for small payloads, and <0.5% 5xx rate. I'll add a scripted harness to reproduce production mix.

marco: We also need an explicit customer-facing credit policy for cost spikes. FinOps: suggest a capped credit of $X or email opt-in?

finops-bot: @marco Suggested policy: automatic 72h investigation window, eligible customers get a one-time credit up to $500 or a pro-rated account credit. Legal to sign off on wording.

devon: For rollback, propose these gates: availability < 99% sustained 10m OR error-rate > 2% for 5m -> immediate revert to pilot config. Revert must be executable via infra CLI in < 3m. Will add commands to runbook: 

```
# revert traffic to pilot
infra cutover rollback --env prod --slice pilot
# verify
infra check routes --env prod
```

anya: Alerts: paging thresholds for SRE when error-rate > 1% for 5m OR p99 > 30% over baseline for 10m. Non-paging tickets for token-cost drift > 25%. I'll document examples in the runbook.

ops-bot: Oncall rota updated: primary = riley (Mon-Fri), sat = jules, backup = tan. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/ga-cutover.

marco: OK owners recap: Docs/SDK = anya, SLA/tests + rollback automation = devon, Billing/credits = finops (tbd), Oncall/runbook readiness = ops. Please flag blockers by EOD today.

devon: I'll open the SLA test PR and include a small Jenkins job to run the harness nightly during the burn-in.

anya: PRs planned: docs quickstart (#220) and SDK streaming sample (#221). Tagging @marco @devon for review.

finops-bot: FinOps will draft credit wording and post here.

marco: Thanks all. Final sign-off required: Product (marco), Eng (devon), SRE (riley), Docs (anya), FinOps/legal signoff. If we have green checks by Tue EOD, schedule cutover Wed 10:00.
